description: the man of the reference picture riding: the embodiment of eternal winter, fair skin touched by frost with rosy cheeks, long white hair and a long white beard, white eyebrows, a warm human face in clean profile, eyes glowing pale cyan, a tall crown of long pale icicles, a thick white fur collar, armour of green-teal ice crystal plates over dark midnight blue, a long cloak of the green, teal and violet lights of an aurora hanging behind from the shoulders, its edge clean and outlined, ice crystal greaves and dark boots, no sceptre and nothing in the hands but the reins; sitting tall and upright astride a saddle that is not drawn, the back straight, not squatting and not crouching, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing right, the head, chest and hips turned fully to the right; both forearms reaching forward, the two hands together in front of the body holding short reins that end just in front of the hands; only the near leg showing and only one foot in the whole picture: the thigh lying forward and level from the hip to the knee, the knee bent at a right angle, the lower leg hanging vertically straight down from the knee, one whole foot at the bottom with the toes pointing right; the cloak and any long hair hanging down behind the back, not spread out; the far leg completely hidden and not drawn at all, no second boot and no second foot; the whole figure from the tips of the icicle crown to the sole of the foot inside the picture with room around it; nothing under the rider; isolated figure on a plain background

references.usage: the character's look: this same man, his face, hair, beard, icicle crown, fur collar, ice armour, aurora cloak and colours, drawn the same way; not his standing pose and not the sceptre
